notes: Imagery-derived footprint estimates, not a current field survey.
Height estimates are retained in the source subset but not used as surveyed heights; the unchanged house default of one to two storeys applies.
Negative IDs are local supplemental IDs, never OSM IDs. OSM coast, roads and district anchors are retained.
